name: slides-from-textbook
description: Turn a textbook chapter (or any structured prose) into an interactive slide deck. Overrides chunking to chunk by slide-candidate (per concept/section), adds a slide-rendering skill that maps entries to slide component types, and ships a plan_md_template tailored to the 6-phase slide-deck pipeline. Inspired by the team's lesson2slides subsite. Functional example, not production-ready.
author: memect
